headline: Stlican Shelf and Kuura Strand Erupt as Northern Fronts Shift
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the front has widened significantly as Stlican Shelf and Kuura Strand erupted into sharp fighting while Weathered Expanse continues to churn. In Weathered Expanse, relentless skirmishing over Wightwalk and Crow's Nest yielded six base transitions and more than 2,600 combined casualties in the last two hours, leaving multiple strongpoints in ruins. Stlican Shelf surged back into high volatility with eight strategic turnovers during the same window, driven by ferocious clashes near Briar alongside accelerating casualty lists for both sides. Kuura Strand registered a sudden localized storm, producing eight base events between Martti and Menneen to destabilize the northern perimeter. Movement also rekindled along Nevish Line, where four base exchanges unfolded around Blinding Stones and Blackcoat Way. Conversely, strategic conversions stalled in Callahan's Passage despite ongoing heavy combat exceeding 2,000 casualties in two hours, while Palantine Berm and Mooring County have largely settled into a lull in base turnover.
